caseName: Luzaitis v. Municipal Court of Los Angeles Judicial District
caseNameFull: Luzaitis v. Municipal Court of Los Angeles Judicial District, County of Los Angeles

opinions.text: Appeal from Ct. App. Cal., 2d App. Dist., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, cer-tiorari denied.
